name: authkit-aurelia-repo
description: AuthKit for Aurelia v1 and v2: session service, HTTP interceptor, router guard and server-driven Cl@ve federation.

scripts.test: npm --prefix authkit-aurelia test && npm --prefix authkit-aurelia2 test

scripts.build: npm --prefix authkit-aurelia run build && npm --prefix authkit-aurelia2 run build
